newsitem.title: UK: Impl.Tobacco up after positive press comment.
newsitem.headline: Impl.Tobacco up after positive press comment.

text.p: Shares in Imperial Tobacco Plc rose in pre-market trading on Monday after positive press comment on the stock, dealers said.
Against the declining trend of the market overall, Imperial shares were quoted up 1-1/2p at 409-1/2 by 0712 GMT, though no volume was recorded in the stock.
The Financial Times Lex column on Saturday said Imperial had advantages over Gallaher, which makes its market debut after a demerger from American Brands on May 30.
It said Imperial had a better record on profits and productivity than Gallaher and that the latter's marketing skills would count for less if the UK government as promised bans cigarette advertising.
It added that Imperial has a "firmer commitment to dividend growth."
